WHERE THE CONVICTION SITS - ONE BET: the book is one long-tape bet, not twenty ideas. Ten long share lines, nine calls and one put. The tech/semis cluster carries most of it: AMD, LITE, SMCI, MU, VRT, CRWD, GOOGL, META and AAPL in shares, and TSLA, AVGO, CDNS, GLW and WDC in options. I rank that cluster as ONE bet with AMD (the top share median, 64) and TSLA (the room's #1 leg, 60.0) as its best expressions. Twenty lines on one tape are one bet, and nothing in this book hedges the cluster. Off the cluster are GM (a value floor), LMT (the sheet's strongest residual), UPS, FCX and KO (calls on non-tech names) and CMG, the book's only put and only short view.

The AMD, AAPL, LITE, CRWD, SMCI and MU share lines stack on open same-side calls, and the VRT and AAPL share lines sit OPPOSITE the open r66-run61-VRT $185P and r66-run58-AAPL $340P. They are recorded as stacked and opposite, not as hedges, and no further ticket opens on those names. (2) EXITS - each share line exits on its close-basis kill or at its stated horizon, whichever comes first, so AMD, SMCI and VRT close at today's close. Each option leg follows its EXIT line: ratchet at its break-even, kill on the underlying's close, else close on 2026-11-05 for TSLA, LMT and AVGO and on 2026-11-19 for the seven 2026-11-20 legs. On LMT, AVGO and GLW the house kill sits past the point where the stand-in delta 0.5 has spent the premium, and TSLA (0.78 of 14.5) and CMG (0.25 of 1.41) keep almost nothing at theirs, so the premium is the real stop; WDC keeps 26.95 of 49.4, CDNS 13.97 of 26.84 and UPS 4.23 of 6.65. Kills on two or more of TSLA, AVGO, CDNS, GLW and WDC at the same close are read as one tech-tape bet failing, not as separate bad draws. (3) WINDFALL - when a leg's served mark rises to 2 x its premium at a freeze, half is banked at that mark and the record is written before the next freeze (R148); the other half rides to its own exit. No held contract's freeze mark is served this morning, so the 35 claims not printed EXITED read WINDFALL STATE UNWRITTEN, except r66-run60-NFLX, served FIRED at the 2026-10-22 close and banking at the 2026-10-23 freeze mark, which the next court reads.
